# JSON for Modern C++

Version: 3.11.3. Author: Niels Lohmann and contributors.

`json.hpp` is an unmodified single-header distribution. The upstream MIT license is preserved in `LICENSE.MIT` and the header. These third-party files retain their original license and are not covered by restrictions on this project's original source.

Upstream: https://github.com/nlohmann/json

Local source used: the already-vendored toml11 test dependency under the workspace's gta4-rtx research checkout. No GTA game files or code were copied.
